global_prompt: A long-haired man and a group of people on a vast desert road.

chunks.content: The long-haired man stands facing the camera with a neutral expression, his mouth slightly open, looking forward. He is positioned on a long, empty desert road with distant rock formations under a clear sky. The camera is static, capturing him in a medium shot.

The long-haired man stands on a desert road, looking forward with a weary expression. The scene features a wide-open, empty desert road stretching into the distance under a clear blue sky, with low hills visible on the horizon. The camera captures him in a medium close-up, facing directly towards the viewer.

A group of people walks towards the camera on a long, empty desert road, with distant rock formations under a clear sky. The long-haired man stands in the foreground, facing away from the camera, looking towards the approaching group. The camera is positioned behind the long-haired man, capturing the scene from his perspective.
